correctness.rationale: In a length-at-most-r|w| cyclic occurrence containing a block end, there are between 1 and |w| consecutive block ends. Their input letters give a legal cyclic input factor. Reposition it at an attracting occurrence while preserving the start offset and end padding: every non-end symbol is c, so the same output factor now includes a lifted mark. This works with wraparound and without injectivity of g. If there is no end, the factor is c^t with t≤r−1; a marked image ending in c supplies a run crossing its end. The lifted positions are distinct. My independent exact replay used two-adic valuation parity of one-based positions (the odd positions give 0 and the even positions flip the corresponding input letter), integer encodings of cyclic substrings, and a rolling window of exact occurrence IDs to test every bichromatic pair. At order three all lengths yield precisely (1,3),(1,4),(2,5),(3,5),(3,7). A two-element attractor must hit both letters, so it supplies the mark with g(a)=0 for the next period-doubling lift. Iterating i↦2i+1 gives the five formulas and optimality by the two singleton factors. For each order from 4 to 13, the listed lengths with bichromaticity left exactly the five predicted pairs. These filters are necessary for any attractor, and the lift gives sufficiency of every survivor; no sufficiency assumption about the test lengths is made. At order 13 the independent bichromatic scan gives 2733 candidates after length 2049, then 1369 after 1025 and 5 after 513, in a different filter order from the frozen log.
residual_risks: The finite exclusion argument stops at order 13. Only existence, optimality and the five particular minimum pairs are established for every order n≥3.

evidence: Writing N=2^n, the length-(2N−1) prefix is D_n D_n[0:N−1], up to a consistent change of alphabet: the two length-N morphic blocks differ only at the last symbol. It contains every length≤N cyclic factor. Projecting a size-two linear attractor of this longer prefix modulo N gives a circular attractor: every cyclic factor occurs in the prefix and a marked linear occurrence projects to a marked cyclic occurrence. Both symbols ensure size exactly two.
This implication gives optimal cardinality but no list of five distinct projected pairs, no exclusion of other pairs, and no general lift.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The size assertion is a short consequence of known ingredients and is not the originality basis. The explicit circular choices and their completeness over the specified orders, together with the uniform marked-end transfer, are the remaining distinct results.

originality.rationale: Credit the full five-position-family guarantee, exact finite census, and marked constant-prefix circular lift. Do not credit linear size two, the two previously classified linear pairs as linear attractors, or the bare circular cardinality conclusion as separate discoveries. In fact the latter follows from the known linear optimum two for every prefix and a periodic-prefix reduction. The compared sources do not supply the five specific circular choices, the finite exhaustion, or the general single-end lift.
residual_risks: The direct Mantaci et al. text was unavailable; only Romana's precise attribution was used. The bounded searches do not exclude an earlier equivalent under other terminology. The inaccessible minimal-unique-substring full text was not treated as proof of nonoverlap.

value.rationale: For a canonical substitution family, the exact choice and multiplicity of optimal marks are finer than the minimum size, especially since the circular seam permits more possibilities than the linear classification. The five formulaic configurations provide persistent witnesses, the finite census distinguishes those witnesses from a claimed all-orders uniqueness theorem, and the marked-end lemma isolates a size-preserving condition that applies beyond this substitution. The value does not depend on the bare number two or on extending the finite census arbitrarily.
residual_risks: All-orders exhaustion is neither established nor needed for the narrower result; no lift for arbitrary morphisms is asserted.
